segments.text:
V. 12.
I have yet many things to ſay—Concerning my Paſſion, Death, Reſurerction, and the Conſequences of it. Theſe Things we have, not in uncertain Traditions, but in the Acts, the Epiſtles, and the Revelation. But ye cannot bear them now—Both becauſe of your Littleneſs of Faith, and your immoderate Sorrow.
